headline: Oil Prices Fall on Prospects of Oversupply
summary: Oil prices declined as the International Energy Agency's November report projects global supply exceeding demand in the final quarter of 2026. The agency's forecast drove the downward move.
why: The IEA is the energy-policy body that publishes influential oil market forecasts, and its supply-demand outlook directly affects crude benchmark prices.
why_moved: The IEA's report projecting global oil supply above demand in the last quarter of 2026 is the stated reason for the price decline.
original_headline: Los precios del petróleo bajan ante la perspectiva de una sobreoferta
